title: Normalized stationary cycle/boundary quotient presentation
statement: Let C be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], K an integer-indexed cochain complex, L a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration], and p,n integers. Set A=L.complexStep p n and A'=L.complexStep (p+1) n using [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]; set Z=ker(K.d n (n+1)) as the pullback of bottom and B=im(K.d (n-1) n). Let q be the degree-n component of the quotient projection from L^p K to gr^p K, and P the pullback along the degree-n inclusion of L^p K in K. Put Zbar=im_q(P((A intersection Z)+A')) and Bbar=im_q(P((A intersection B)+A')). For every hBZ:Bbar≤Zbar, the cokernel of this inclusion is isomorphic to the cokernel of the arrow of the pullback, along (A intersection Z).arrow, of (A intersection B)+(A' intersection Z). Equivalently it is (A intersection Z)/((A intersection B)+(A' intersection Z)). No outer-tail, page index, or cohomology assumptions or conclusions occur.

source.place: Tag 012Q, final displayed quotient calculation; Equation 12.24.5.2 in Tag 012P

proof.text: Evaluation in degree n preserves cokernels. Therefore q is epic with kernel the restriction of A′ to A. The normalized image Zbar is the image of A intersection Z under q: adding A′ changes no image, since q kills A′.

The composite A intersection Z onto Zbar onto Zbar/Bbar is epic. Its kernel is the intersection of A intersection Z with (A intersection B)+A′. The differential satisfies d squared zero, so B≤Z; antitonicity gives A′≤A. Modularity then identifies that intersection with (A intersection B)+(A′ intersection Z). Pulling back along the numerator arrow expresses it as a subobject of the numerator.
The abelian first isomorphism theorem identifies the cokernel of that kernel arrow with Zbar/Bbar. This proves the isomorphism for any proof hBZ, by proof irrelevance.

lean.statement:
theorem normalizedStationaryQuotient_presentation
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    {K : CochainComplex C ℤ} (L : DecreasingFiltration K) (p n : ℤ) :
  let A := L.complexStep p n
  let A' := L.complexStep (p + 1) n
  let Z := (Subobject.pullback (K.d n (n + 1))).obj ⊥
  let B := imageSubobject (K.d (n - 1) n)
  let q := (L.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (Int.le_add_one le_rfl)).f n
  let P := Subobject.pullback ((L.step p).arrow.f n)
  let Zbar := (Subobject.«exists» q).obj (P.obj ((A ⊓ Z) ⊔ A'))
  let Bbar := (Subobject.«exists» q).obj (P.obj ((A ⊓ B) ⊔ A'))
  ∀ hBZ : Bbar ≤ Zbar,
    Nonempty (cokernel (Subobject.ofLE Bbar Zbar hBZ) ≅
      cokernel ((Subobject.pullback (A ⊓ Z).arrow).obj
        ((A ⊓ B) ⊔ (A' ⊓ Z))).arrow)
